description: This file defines a Java class PersistableCustomerOptionValuePopulator that extends AbstractDataPopulator. It is responsible for converting a PersistableCustomerOptionValue object into a CustomerOptionValue object, setting properties and descriptions based on the source data, and utilizing a LanguageService to resolve language codes.

classes.name: PersistableCustomerOptionValuePopulator
classes.description: A class that populates a CustomerOptionValue entity from a PersistableCustomerOptionValue source, handling description translations using a LanguageService.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Converts a PersistableCustomerOptionValue into a CustomerOptionValue, setting code, merchant store, sort order, and descriptions with language validation.

methods.name: createTarget
methods.description: Creates a new CustomerOptionValue object (currently returning null).

methods.name: setLanguageService
methods.description: Setter for injecting the LanguageService dependency.
